CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Last_Resubmission_Date__c), DATEVALUE(Initial_Submission_Date__c) + CASE(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Initial_Submission_Date__c)), 1, 5, /* Sunday -> Due Friday (+5 days) */ 2, 4, /* Monday -> Due Friday (+4 days) */ 3, 6, /* Tuesday -> Due Monday (+6 days) */ 4, 6, /* Wednesday -> Due Tuesday (+6 days) */ 5, 6, /* Thursday -> Due Wednesday(+6 days) */ 6, 6, /* Friday -> Due Thursday (+6 days) */ 7, 6, /* Saturday -> Due Friday (+6 days) */ 5 ), DATEVALUE(Last_Resubmission_Date__c) + CASE(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Last_Resubmission_Date__c)), 1, 5, /* Sunday -> Due Friday (+5 days) */ 2, 4, /* Monday -> Due Friday (+4 days) */ 3, 6, /* Tuesday -> Due Monday (+6 days) */ 4, 6, /* Wednesday -> Due Tuesday (+6 days) */ 5, 6, /* Thursday -> Due Wednesday(+6 days) */ 6, 6, /* Friday -> Due Thursday (+6 days) */ 7, 6, /* Saturday -> Due Friday (+6 days) */ 5 ) )
CustomField.label: Due Date
